# django-admin-extended

A Django package that enhances the Django admin UI/UX with charts, bookmarks, custom views, and improved model admin features.

## Installation

```python
# settings.py
INSTALLED_APPS = [
    'admin_extended',                  # required
    'admin_extended.bookmarks',        # optional — bookmark sidebar feature
    'admin_extended.charts',           # optional — time series chart feature
    # ... other apps
]
```

`admin_extended.bookmarks` and `admin_extended.charts` are independent sub-apps with their own migrations. Only add them if you need those features.

No URL configuration needed. The package overrides Django admin templates automatically.

## Settings

Configure via `ADMIN_EXTENDED` dict in `settings.py`:

```python
ADMIN_EXTENDED = {
    'MENU_APP_ORDER': ['myapp', 'otherapp'],   # Sidebar app ordering by app_label
    'MENU_MODEL_ORDER': ['MyModel', 'Other'],  # Model ordering within app sections
    'APP_ICON': {                              # FontAwesome Free 5 icon per app
        'myapp': 'fas fa-users',
        'store': 'fas fa-shopping-cart',
    },
    'TABBED_INLINES': True,         # Render inlines as tabs (default: True)
    'AUTO_RAW_ID_FIELDS': False,         # Auto-set raw_id/autocomplete for FK fields
}
```

---

## Core: ExtendedAdminModel

The primary base class. Use instead of `admin.ModelAdmin`.

```python
from admin_extended.core import ExtendedAdminModel
from django.contrib import admin

@admin.register(MyModel)
class MyModelAdmin(ExtendedAdminModel):
    list_display = ('name', 'status', 'owner')
```

### View / Edit / Add modes

Change pages open in **view** (read-only) mode by default. Users switch to edit mode via `?edit=1` in the URL. This is handled automatically — no extra code needed.

Control which fields appear per mode:

```python
class MyModelAdmin(ExtendedAdminModel):
    # Only visible in view mode (also: any field prefixed with display_)
    view_only_fields = ['display_summary', 'computed_value']

    # Only visible in edit/add modes
    edit_only_fields = ['internal_notes']

    # Only visible to superusers (in list_display and fieldsets)
    superuser_only_fields = ['secret_flag']
```

### Inline tabs

```python
class MyModelAdmin(ExtendedAdminModel):
    tabbed_inlines = True  # default from settings; renders inlines as Bootstrap tabs
    inlines = [OrderInline, NoteInline]
```

### Delete without confirm

```python
class MyModelAdmin(ExtendedAdminModel):
    skip_delete_confirm = True  # replaces default delete action
```

### HTML helpers (free functions in admin_extended.display)

```python
from admin_extended.display import html_img, html_link, html_color, html_json
from admin_extended.display.html import SUCCESS, ERROR, WARNING, DEFAULT

def display_photo(self, obj):
    return html_img(obj.photo.url, height='80px')

def display_link(self, obj):
    return html_link(obj.url, title='Open')

def display_status(self, obj):
    color = SUCCESS if obj.is_active else ERROR
    return html_color(obj.get_status_display(), color)

def display_payload(self, obj):
    return html_json(obj.payload)
```

Color constants in `admin_extended.display.html`: `SUCCESS`, `ERROR`, `WARNING`, `DEFAULT`.

### FK links in list_display (DisplayLinkAdapter)

Foreign key fields in `list_display` are automatically rendered as clickable links to the related object's change page. Disable with:

```python
class MyModelAdmin(ExtendedAdminModel):
    enable_foreign_link = False
```

---

## Object Tools

Add custom action buttons to change-form or change-list pages using the `@object_tool` decorator.

```python
from admin_extended.core import ExtendedAdminModel
from admin_extended.object_tools import object_tool
from django.http import HttpResponseRedirect

@admin.register(Order)
class OrderAdmin(ExtendedAdminModel):
    # GET tool — appears in the object-tools bar at the top of the change form
    change_form_object_tools = ['send_invoice']

    # POST tool — appears in the submit row at the bottom of the change form
    change_form_object_tools = ['approve_order']

    # Tool on the change list page
    change_list_object_tools = ['export_csv']

    @object_tool(icon='fas fa-envelope', name='send_invoice', label='Send Invoice')
    def send_invoice(self, request, object_id):
        # do work
        return HttpResponseRedirect('../')

    @object_tool(
        icon='fas fa-check',
        name='approve_order',
        label='Approve',
        method='post',
        post_param_title='Confirm Approval'  # shown as button label in submit row
    )
    def approve_order(self, request, object_id):
        # do work
        return HttpResponseRedirect('../')

    @object_tool(icon='fas fa-download', name='export_csv', label='Export CSV')
    def export_csv(self, request):
        # do work
        return HttpResponse(...)
```

---

## DefaultModelAdmin & Auto-registration

`DefaultModelAdmin` extends `ExtendedAdminModel` and auto-populates `list_display` (all non-text, non-ID fields) and `list_filter` (fields with choices), and adds `select_related` for all FK fields.

```python
from admin_extended.autoregister import DefaultModelAdmin, auto_register
from django.contrib import admin

# Register a specific model with smart defaults
@admin.register(MyModel)
class MyModelAdmin(DefaultModelAdmin):
    pass  # list_display and list_filter populated automatically

# Or register ALL models in the project with DefaultModelAdmin
# (skips already-registered models and Django built-in models)
auto_register(
    default_admin=DefaultModelAdmin,              # optional custom subclass
    ignore=['myapp.SensitiveModel'],              # format: "app_label.ModelName"
)
```

---

## CustomTableAdminPage

Replace a model's changelist with a fully custom HTML table page.

```python
from admin_extended.custom_pages import CustomTableAdminPage, TableData
from django.contrib import admin

class ReportProxy(MyModel):
    class Meta:
        proxy = True

@admin.register(ReportProxy)
class ReportAdmin(CustomTableAdminPage):
    model = ReportProxy

    def get_table_data(self):
        table = TableData(header='Monthly Summary')
        table.table_titles = ['Month', 'Orders', 'Revenue']
        for row in get_monthly_stats():
            table.add_rows([row.month, row.orders, row.revenue])
        return [table]
```

---

## Time Series Charts

Create database-driven charts via the Django admin without writing code.

Requires `admin_extended.charts` in `INSTALLED_APPS`.

1. Navigate to **Admin Extended Charts → Time Series Charts** and create a chart record.
2. Fill in: target `app_label`, `model_name`, `time_field` (DateTimeField name), `aggregate` (COUNT/SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX), `aggregate_field`.
3. Optionally set `split_field` to produce multi-series charts, or `filter_field` + `filters` to pre-filter data.
4. Optionally set `max_points` (cap returned buckets) and `cache_seconds` (per-chart result caching).
5. View the chart at `/admin/admin_extended_charts/timeserieschart/<id>/chart/`.

The JSON metrics API is at `/admin/admin_extended_charts/timeserieschart/<id>/metrics/` (query params: `time_range`, `scale`, `filters`).

---

## Bookmarks

Requires `admin_extended.bookmarks` in `INSTALLED_APPS`.

Bookmarks appear in the admin sidebar as a pinned section. Manage them at **Admin Extended Bookmarks → Bookmarks**. The CSRF-disabled POST endpoint has been removed; manage bookmarks through the standard admin change form.

---

## Management Command

```bash
# Visualize migration dependency tree for one or more apps
python manage.py migration_graph myapp otherapp
```

---

## FontAwesome Icons

FontAwesome Free 5.15.4 is included. Use class strings like `fas fa-users`, `far fa-calendar`, `fab fa-github` anywhere the package accepts an `icon` parameter.

Icon reference: https://fontawesome.com/v5.15/icons?d=gallery&p=2&m=free
